item.title: Cornered
item.description: A man seeks vengeance at all costs when his wife is murdered.

item.title: Don't Bother to Knock
item.description: When troubled Nell Forbes (Marilyn Monroe) is hired to babysit for the Joneses at a New York hotel, it isn't long before her path crosses with that of airline pilot Jed Towers, who is in the midst of a lovers' spat.

item.title: The House on Telegraph Hill
item.description: A woman assumes the identity of another and finds herself caught in a murderous plot with a mysterious husband.

item.title: Leave Her to Heaven
item.description: A writer's quick romance with a socialite takes a turn when her love drives her to extremes.

item.title: Murder, My Sweet
item.description: After being hired to find an ex-con's former girlfriend, Philip Marlowe is drawn into a deeply complex web of mystery and deceit.

item.title: Tension
item.description: A meek pharmacist creates an alternate identity under which he plans to murder the bullying liquor salesman who has become his wife's lover.

item.title: Born to Kill
item.description: A self-seeking woman discovers that her secret love may have a connection to a murder.

item.title: No Way Out
item.description: A doctor becomes the target of a bigoted criminal who blames him for the death of his brother.

item.title: Dangerous Crossing
item.description: Aboard an ocean liner, a newlywed bride becomes the target of a murder conspiracy when her husband goes into hiding.

item.title: Blonde Ice
item.description: A society reporter keeps herself in the headlines by marrying a series of wealthy men, all of whom die under mysterious circumstances.
